pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: select (select A.CLAIMID from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "POLICYDECLARATIONNO", B.NOKLAIM as "IDPEGA", "TABLEOBJECTNAME", (select TO_CHAR (a.REGISTERDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "REGISTERID", (select TO_CHAR (a.transferpic_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "WARRANTYNO", (SELECT TO_CHAR (MIN (tanggal + 12 / 24), 'dd/mm/yyyy') FROM os_akseptasi_klaim WHERE caseid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM) AS "pyCountry", (select TO_CHAR (a.DATEOFREQUESTDOCUMENT, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "THEINSURED", (select TO_CHAR (a.SURVEYDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "BUSINESSCODE", B.PIC AS "OLDPOLICYNO", (select REPLACE (a.closeclaimnote, CHR (10), ' ') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "GROUPPANEL", (select TO_CHAR (a.investigator_tf_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "SOBLEADER1", (select TO_CHAR (a.ANALYSTTORCLPUCL_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "SOBLEADER2", (select TO_CHAR (a.RCLPUCL_TF_TOANALYST, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "SOBLEADER0", (select a.RCLPUCL from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "SOBNAME", (select TO_CHAR (a.COMPLIANCE_CREATEDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "SOURCEOFBUSINESS", (select TO_CHAR (a.CPLVALID_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "ISMAINFOLLOWING", (select TO_CHAR (a.POSTAUDIT_TF_ANALYSTDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "STATUSBUSINESS", (select TO_CHAR (a.CPLPOSTAUDIT_VALIDDATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "EDMTYPE", (select a.ALASANKETERLAMBATAN from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "MARKETINGCODE", (select a.businesscode from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "BUSINESSNAME", (SELECT b.lsc_note FROM v_sts_claim b WHERE (select a.StatusClaim from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) = b.LSC_ID) AS "CLIENTID", (select a.SOBNAME from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "ISFOLLOWINGCHILD", B.NOKLAIM AS "pyNote", (select x.pxcreateoperator from datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work x where x.pzinskey='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM) AS "pyLabel", (select TO_CHAR (a.TGLDOKLENGKAP, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "pyGroup", (select TO_CHAR (a.trf_to_investigator, 'dd/mm/yyyy') from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC a where A.CLAIMNO='ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK '||B.NOKLAIM and A.NOPOLIS=B.NOPOLIS) AS "pzInsKey", (select SUBSTR (X.REPORTDATE_1, 0, 8) from datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work x where x.pyid=B.NOKLAIM) AS "IndexSpreading", (SELECT posisi FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_POSISI_PNC z WHERE z.caseid = B.NOKLAIM AND id = (SELECT MAX (id) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_POSISI_PNC WHERE caseid = z.caseid)) AS "pyIssue", (SELECT TO_CHAR (startdate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') FROM t_general WHERE nopolis = B.NOPOLIS AND prodke = B.PROD_KE) AS "PlatNo", (SELECT TO_CHAR (enddate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') FROM t_general WHERE nopolis = B.NOPOLIS AND prodke = B.PROD_KE) AS "Position", to_char(C.TGL_INPUT,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "DISC", to_char(NEXT_FOLLOWUP,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "DISC2", CASE WHEN ( SELECT t.tgl_input FROM pooldata.gcnm_progress_claim t WHERE t.pnccaseid = c.pnccaseid AND t.id_update > c.id_update ORDER BY t.id_update ASC FETCH next 1 row only) IS NULL THEN 'Tercapai' ELSE CASE WHEN trunc(c.next_followup)+1 >= ( SELECT trunc(t.tgl_input) FROM pooldata.gcnm_progress_claim t WHERE t.pnccaseid=c.pnccaseid AND t.id_update>c.id_update ORDER BY t.id_update ASC FETCH next 1 row only) THEN 'Tercapai' ELSE 'Tidak Tercapai' END END as "ASMCityId", C.KETERANGAN as "CARI6", (select STS_PROGRESS1 from POOLDATA.GCNM_MST_PROGRESS x where X.ID_PROGRESS = C.STATUS_PROGRESS1 fetch next 1 row only) AS "AidaAlamat", (select SerialNo from POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G,JSON_TABLE(G.JSONSTATUS_PROGRESS2,'$' columns(nested path '$.ObjectList[*]' COLUMNS (SerialNo varchar2 path '$.SerialNo'))) where G.PNCCASEID = c.PNCCASEID AND G.ID_UPDATE = C.ID_UPDATE and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2','24','60','59') fetch next 1 row only) AS "AidaNama" FROM pooldata.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM c, pooldata.PEGA_DASHBOARDPNC b WHERE c.pnccaseid = b.noklaim and b.STSKLAIM not in ('1','2','3') AND upper(keterangan) NOT LIKE '%AUTO%' and upper(keterangan) NOT LIKE '%SYSTEM%' AND b.pic = c.USER_INPUT and b.pic IN {ASIS:TempDateReport.UserTeknis} AND b.pic != 'ASNET' AND TRUNC (TGL_INPUT) >= TO_DATE ({TempDateReport.NoteKasir}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TRUNC (TGL_INPUT) <= TO_DATE ({TempDateReport.AnaylstRemarks}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') {ASIS:TempLaporan.UserTeknis}
